name: Stolen Booty
summary: Along Ratchet’s coast, Gazlowe weighs two stolen goods against the rest of the cargo. Boots for local laborers and a delicate lens are needed to finish his observatory.

sections.title: Pirate Hijacking
sections.body: For years, Southsea Freebooters have troubled merchant lanes across the Great Sea. Their fortified camp just south of Ratchet brought them into direct conflict with Gazlowe. Pirates intercepted merchant vessels bound for the port and seized valuable supplies from the Steamwheedle Cartel. Some cargo could be counted as a shipping loss. Other goods mattered enough for Gazlowe to hire mercenaries to break into the pirate stronghold.

sections.title: The Missing Pieces
sections.body: Gazlowe has two practical priorities. Drizzlik sent a needed shipment of boots from Booty Bay for local laborers. The other item is a ground telescopic lens made for the observatory tower overlooking Ratchet. Its twin came safely by caravan through Durotar, but pirates seized this lens at sea. Until it is recovered, the observatory remains an empty frame.

faq.q: Why does Gazlowe care so much about these two specific items?
faq.answer: Gazlowe cannot recover all the cargo, but the boots from Drizzlik in Booty Bay and the telescopic lens cannot be replaced. Local workers need the boots, and the precision lens is needed to finish the observatory overlooking Ratchet.

faq.q: Where did the two observatory lenses come from?
aliases: how did gazlowe get the lenses
faq.answer: The observatory needs two lenses. The larger one came safely overland by caravan through Durotar. Southsea Freebooters intercepted the smaller lens, sent by sea, off the Barrens coast.
Drizzlik is a goblin cobbler in Booty Bay, in the southern Eastern Kingdoms. He made and sent boots for Gazlowe’s crews in Ratchet before pirates seized the ship carrying them.

faq.q: Where are the stolen items hidden?
faq.answer: The crates of boots and the telescopic lens are hidden in the Southsea pirate camp on the Merchant Coast, just south of Ratchet.

aliases: what is next after stolen booty
faq.answer: Gazlowe thanks you and praises your reliability when you return the items. He invites you to keep working for his commercial enterprise in Ratchet.

faq.q: Why does Ratchet have an observatory?
aliases: why does gazlowe want a telescope
faq.answer: Goblin engineering depends on observation, navigation, and surveying nearby land and sea lanes. A completed observatory tower lets Ratchet’s leaders watch merchant fleets, rival vessels, and threats along the Merchant Coast.

angles.text: Gazlowe’s observatory brings goblin precision optics into coastal construction. Practical building needs both heavy work and delicate glasswork.
Boots sent from Drizzlik in Booty Bay show how finished leather goods and cobbling move through Steamwheedle ports.
